# HR University

> HR University is the #1 online platform for HR professional certification programs, training, and career resources.

HR University offers comprehensive certification programs in HR management, generalist roles, diversity and inclusion, business partnership, people analytics, and change management. The platform also features an HR job board, learning resources, and industry partnerships with SHRM and leading organizations.

## Key Topics

- HR Certification Programs
- HR Generalist Certification
- HR Management Certification
- Diversity and Inclusion Certification
- People Analytics Certification
- Change Management Certification
- HR Business Partner Certification
- SHRM Certification
- Professional Development
- HR Career Development
- Online Learning
- HR Job Board
- Talent Acquisition
- Workplace DEI
- HR Training

## Certification Programs

- [Best Human Resources (HR) Certifications Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online): Main certification programs page showcasing HR Generalist, Management, Diversity, and Business Partner certifications.
- [Best HR Generalist Certification Course Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/hr-generalist-certification): HR Generalist Certification course for foundational HR professional skills and career development.
- [Best HR Management Certification Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/human-resources-management-certification): HR Management Certification course details covering employee management and disciplinary practices.
- [Best HR Business Partner Certification Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/hr-business-partner-certification-course): HR Business Partner Certification focusing on HR strategy implementation and organizational growth.
- [Best Diversity and Inclusion Certification Course Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/diversity-and-inclusion-certification): Diversity and Inclusion Certification for leading workplace DEI initiatives with SHRM credits.
- [Best People Analytics Certification Course 2025](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/people-analytics-certification-course): People Analytics Certification teaching data-driven decision-making and workforce analytics skills.
- [Best Change Management Certification Online](https://hr.university/hr-certification-online/change-management-certification): Change Management Certification for implementing organizational change with case studies and capstone.

## HR Job Board & Careers

- [Find HR Jobs Near You](https://hr.university/hr-jobs): HR job board featuring generalist, specialist, coordinator, analyst, VP, and director positions.
- [Post an HR Job - HR University](https://hr.university/post-an-hr-job): Free HR job posting service for employers to recruit HR professionals.
- [10 Best Director of HR Jobs](https://hr.university/hr-jobs/hr-director): Job listings for Director of HR positions across multiple companies.
- [10 Best HR Analyst Jobs](https://hr.university/hr-jobs/hr-analyst): HR Analyst job listings featuring talent acquisition and HR career opportunities.
- [10 Best HR Assistant Jobs](https://hr.university/hr-jobs/hr-assistant): Entry-level HR Assistant job listings and employment opportunities.
- [10 Best Chief Human Resources Officer Jobs](https://hr.university/hr-jobs/chief-human-resources): CHRO executive-level job listings for Chief Human Resources Officer positions.

## Learning Resources & Career Guides

- [Learn - HR University](https://hr.university/learn): Learning platform with HR training, benefits guides, DEI resources, and compliance materials.
- [How to Become a Great HR Manager](https://hr.university/career/hr-manager/how-to-become-an-hr-manager): Actionable guide on HR manager career path, skills, and staffing/recruitment functions.
- [SHRM Certification CP and SCP Review: Is it Worth it?](https://hr.university/training/shrm-certification): SHRM certification review comparing CP and SCP credentials, eligibility, and career value.
